snapshot.capital_scaled: ₹20–60 lakh for a licensed production unit, wider distribution and export
snapshot.distribution_note: Online, WhatsApp and local shops sell well; national retail is crowded

tailwinds: Regional pickles, chutneys and papads have loyal buyers across India and among the diaspora.
Homemade and grandmother's-recipe brands sell well online.
Long shelf life makes national shipping and export possible.
PMFME subsidies and ODOP support help small food units.
headwinds: Many home brands compete, and big brands dominate shelves.
Oil and raw material prices have risen.
Jars are heavy and break in shipping.
Consistency is hard when production grows beyond one kitchen.
angle_2026: Home-style pickle and chutney brands have grown online by selling regional recipes that big brands don't make. In 2026, the brands that grow pick a region and a story, keep recipes authentic, and invest in packaging that ships safely.
cost_basis: Estimated for a home or small licensed kitchen making 5–8 products, selling online and locally, 2026 prices.

setup_costs.covers: Cutting, mixing, storage jars, drying racks
Seasonal vegetables and fruits, oil, spices
Glass or PET jars, labels, shipping boxes

unit_economics.example: For a ₹350 jar of pickle (400 g):
unit_economics.note: Bundles of 3–4 jars cut shipping cost per jar. Seasonal pickles, such as raw mango in summer, drive annual repeat orders.

investor_probes: How do you keep taste consistent at scale?
What is your breakage rate in shipping?
How long is your shelf life?
bootstrap_takeaway: Start from your kitchen with FSSAI registration, sell to friends, WhatsApp groups and local shops, and grow online once buyers reorder.
sourcing_edge: Buy seasonal produce directly from farmers or mandis at harvest and cold-pressed oil from local mills.
licences: GST registration once above the threshold

hard_truths.title: Consistency
hard_truths.text: Home recipes vary batch to batch. Write down exact measurements.

hard_truths.title: Breakage
hard_truths.text: Glass jars break in courier. Use PET or strong packaging.

hard_truths.title: Seasonal supply
hard_truths.text: Raw mangoes and some vegetables are only available for a few weeks. Plan production and cash.

hard_truths.title: Crowded market
hard_truths.text: Many brands sell similar pickles. Your region and recipe must stand out.

plan_goal: The aim is ₹1 lakh in sales, with at least 30% repeat buyers.

plan.title: Sell
steps: Sell through WhatsApp, local shops and online.
